Retail Landlords Need to Underwrite Their Tenants’ Customer Base, Too: Landlords underwrite the retail tenant. But they almost never underwrite the tenant’s customer.

Madewell To Open New Store at Tishman Speyer’s 1 Rockefeller Plaza: Famed denim and clothing brand Madewell is opening a new store at Tishman Speyer ’s 1 Rockefeller Plaza , the landlord announced Thursday. The retailer signed a 7,340-square-foot lease at the Midtown landmark, where its new space will open in 2027.

items.headline: Whole Foods to Open Daily Shop at Murray Hill’s 509 Third Avenue
items.summary: Whole Foods Market has leased a 9,000-square-foot retail space in Manhattan’s Murray Hill neighborhood. The 15-year deal occupies a ground-floor space and outdoor terraces at 509 Third Avenue , according to a memorandum of lease filed in city records Friday morning. The 35-story, 229-unit apartment tower, known as the Murray , was developed by Kahen Properties with Lalezarian Properties . A spokesperson for Whole Foods confirmed the lease in an email to Commercial Observer, but declined to share further details.…

items.headline: Burlington Takes 44K SF at Bay Ridge Retail Center Development
items.summary: Off-price retailer Burlington has inked a 44,070-square-foot retail lease at Century Marketplace , a new retail development coming to 458 86th Street in Bay Ridge, Brooklyn, developer MCB Real Estate announced Tuesday. The site between Fourth and Fifth avenues is undergoing a $130 million mixed-use redevelopment to turn the former 14-lot Century 21 department store assemblage into a 95,000-square-foot retail center.…

items.headline: Fields West in Frisco Hits 75% Pre-Lease With New Tenants
items.summary: Fields West, a Frisco mixed-use development, has pre-leased 75% of its retail and dining space with seven new tenants. The new leases include brands like Lululemon, Boll & Branch, and Flower Child, bringing the roster to 44 retail and restaurant tenants. This adds momentum to the 55-acre urban village, part of the 2,545-acre Fields master plan aiming for 11M SF of commercial and office space.…

items.headline: Retail Landlords Need to Underwrite Their Tenants’ Customer Base, Too
items.summary: Landlords underwrite the retail tenant. But they almost never underwrite the tenant’s customer. They should. That gap costs landlords money, and it is fixable before a listing goes live. The standard leasing process is too reactive: Review comparable rents, post the space on Crexi and LoopNet, wait for responses, and then vet an operator’s finances. Mark Kvetkovskiy. None of that tells you whether enough of that retailer’s customers live near the space.…

items.headline: Simon Property to More Than Double $18M in Lost Saks Rents
items.summary: Simon Property Group is re-leasing more than 1 million square feet vacated by Saks Fifth Avenue at rents 144% above what the bankrupt retailer had been paying. The REIT projects replacing $18M in annual Saks base rents with $44M from new tenants — adding roughly $26M in net operating income as leases are executed and tenants open. The re-leasing spread signals that Saks’ Chapter 11 exit may be unlocking value for Class A mall landlords by clearing anchor rents that had been below market for years.…

items.headline: Madewell To Open New Store at Tishman Speyer’s 1 Rockefeller Plaza
items.summary: Famed denim and clothing brand Madewell is opening a new store at Tishman Speyer ’s 1 Rockefeller Plaza , the landlord announced Thursday. The retailer signed a 7,340-square-foot lease at the Midtown landmark, where its new space will open in 2027. The asking rent and the length of the lease were not disclosed, but the average asking rent for retail space in Midtown Plaza District was $2,540 per square foot during the second quarter of 2026, according to CBRE data .…

items.headline: Planet Fitness Takes 15K SF at Coney Island Residential Development
items.summary: Wake up, it’s time for a workout. Planet Fitness has inked a 14,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of a new residential tower in Coney Island, Brooklyn, with Cammeby’s International Group and Rybak Development . Planet Fitness will move into the space at 532 Neptune Avenue next year on a 10-year lease with an asking rent of $65 per square foot, according to the New York Business Journal , which first reported the deal.…

items.headline: Blackstone Buys Palm Beach Retail From Ken Griffin for $86M
items.summary: Blackstone is acquiring a 49K SF Worth Avenue property from Ken Griffin’s Citadel entity for $86M. This deal marks another major transaction on Palm Beach’s premier retail corridor, which currently boasts less than 1% retail vacancy. The sale underscores investor demand and surging rents in South Florida’s luxury retail market, with county-level sales totaling $690M through H1 2026.…

items.headline: Flex Retail Propels Triangle Region’s Retail Revival
items.summary: Flex retail assets are seeing heightened leasing demand in Raleigh’s Triangle region, with single-story office conversions on the rise. Vacancy rates for retail spaces under 10K SF have dropped to 1.6% in Q2, per Colliers, outpacing larger format properties. The surge in flex retail points to shifting consumer preferences and a regional uptick in both retail development and investment.…

items.headline: Simon Ups 2026 Outlook on Strong Leasing, New Projects
items.summary: Simon Property Group raised its 2026 earnings guidance after posting strong Q2 leasing and revenue results. The REIT signed over 1,200 leases (4.8M SF), grew base rents, and ramped up development spending with a $4B+ pipeline. Stubbornly high occupancy and robust tenant sales suggest continued momentum in the core US mall sector. Key Takeaways Malls Sustain Momentum Post-Pandemic Simon Property Group shows that the US mall sector’s post-pandemic revival still has legs.…

items.headline: L3 Capital Secures 24K SF for Bylt Basics, Zara Flagships in Williamsburg
items.summary: L3 Capital ’s 108 North Sixth Street and 184-192 Bedford Avenue are welcoming two retail flagships to Williamsburg, Brooklyn. Men’s apparel brand Bylt Basics has selected 108 North Sixth Street, between Berry Street and Wythe Avenue, to host its first permanent New York City storefront, Commercial Observer has learned, in a bold signal of the retail corridor’s growing retail dominance.…

items.headline: Retail Store Closures Outpace Openings, Bigger Boxes Win
items.summary: U.S. retailers posted a net loss of 144 stores through July 2026 as closures narrowly outpaced openings, but incoming locations averaged nearly double the square footage of closing ones, pushing net retail space up 26.1 million square feet, according to Coresight Research. IKEA, Publix, Bass Pro Shops, Meijer and Rural King led large-format expansion, while American Signature, Walgreens and Saks Fifth Avenue accounted for the year’s biggest footprint contractions.…

items.headline: Podcast: How Landlords Can Solve the Tenant Visibility Problem – Sytes’ Rafael Weiss
items.summary: Rafael Weiss is the co-founder of Sytes , a marketplace platform that connects commercial real estate landlords, developers, and brokers with tenants actively looking for space in real time. Rafael came to the problem as a developer who lost a deal because tenant demand was invisible until it was too late, and built Sytes to fix the information asymmetry at the core of retail leasing.…

items.headline: JBL Asset Management Buys Retail Condo Near Miami Design District
items.summary: Alta Developers sold off a retail condo near the Miami Design District for $17.3 million, property records show. JBL Asset Management purchased the 25,504-square-foot asset on the ground floor of the Quadro condo building. The property at 3900 Biscayne Boulevard faces train tracks, just east of the Miami Design District, an open-air, luxury mall. Quadro’s retail tenants include The Shade Store , 7th Avenue furniture store and Waterworks plumbing supply store.…

items.headline: Motek Founders Sign NoMad Lease For New Offshoot Restaurant
items.summary: Happy Corner Hospitality has signed a lease in Manhattan’s NoMad neighborhood for an offshoot of their Motek concept. Known as Yalla Motek , the restaurant group took 2,500 square feet at David and Jack Israel ’s 1147 Broadway , which will be the new Mediterranean restaurant’s first location in New York City and second in the U.S. after opening in Aventura, Fla., in 2022, according to Happy Corner.…

items.headline: Westville To Open at 540 Third Avenue in Murray Hill
items.summary: Westville is getting ready to open its 12th location in the U.S. and bring a selection of classic American foods to Manhattan’s Murray Hill neighborhood. The restaurant brand just signed a 4,148-square-foot lease at the base of 540 Third Avenue , also known as the Dian , a 22-story, 160-unit residential building at the corner of Third Avenue and East 36th Street, according to broker Meridian Capital Group . The lease comprises 2,739 square feet on the ground floor and 1,409 square feet on the lower level.…

items.headline: Principal Financial Group Loans $32M to Refi Queens Shopping Center
items.summary: An affiliate of Mattone Investors secured $32 million to refinance Springnex Plaza , a 96,028-square-foot shopping center anchored by a Stop & Shop supermarket in the Queens neighborhood of Springfield Gardens. Principal Financial Group provided the debt, while Northmarq ’s Robert Delitsky and Charles Cotsalas arranged the transaction. Delitsky noted in a statement that Mattone Investors first developed Springnex Plaza six years ago and “have done a fabulous job maintaining very strong occupancy” since then.…

items.headline: Goodland Pickleball Takes 30K SF for New Indoor Clubs in Brooklyn, Queens
items.summary: Indoor pickleball club operator Goodland Pickleball has secured two new club locations in New York City, Commercial Observer has learned. The long-term leases span a total of 30,100 square feet within Class A buildings in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, and Rego Park, Queens. Goodland, which secured its first indoor New York City club in Brooklyn’s Greenpoint neighborhood in 2024, reports 11,000 visitors to date across the city.…

items.headline: Mexican Restaurant Santo Taco Subleases Former West Village Dig Inn Space
items.summary: Santo Taco is subleasing space formerly occupied by Dig Inn in Manhattan’s West Village, Commercial Observer has learned. The Mexican food concept launched by Santiago Perez in 2025 will take over the 2,800-square-foot, street-level and below-grade space at the Robert Jaffee -owned 232 Bleecker Street at the corner of Bleecker and Carmine streets, according to ManagRE . The sublease runs until 2041.…
